summary: Linear search over a global array of 20-byte records. Starting at lpMem, it iterates dword_8D48F8 records, and for each record tests whether a1 lies within 0x100000 bytes of the DWORD stored at dword index 3 (byte offset 12) using an unsigned difference test. Returns the pointer to the first matching record, or 0 when no record matches.

operations.description: Iterate result from lpMem through lpMem + 20 * dword_8D48F8 over the 20-byte record array.
Advance result by 20 bytes per record.
Test whether the unsigned difference a1 - *(DWORD*)result[3] is below 0x100000, i.e. a1 falls within 0x100000 bytes of the record's key DWORD at dword index 3.
Return the matching record pointer, or 0 when the scan completes without a match.

unresolved: The record layout (20 bytes with a key DWORD at dword index 3) and the meaning of the key value are unproven.
The 0x100000 tolerance suggests a proximity lookup (e.g. address or resource within 1 MB), but the object type and the purpose of the returned record are unknown.
Ownership of the global record array (lpMem, dword_8D48F8) and its initialization are unknown; callers are sub_58AA6F, sub_58B5D4 and sub_58BB68.
The unsigned-difference comparison semantics for negative differences are well defined but the intended use is not confirmed.
